page_title: PAL 0-0 RSO | Las Palmas v Real Sociedad 25/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+1' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Guillermo Cuadra had an easy-decision to make.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
89' Las Palmas have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
86' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Real Sociedad) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post.

86' Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas) receives a low pass just outside the box and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Alex Remiro pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
84' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Las Palmas.

83' Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas) wastes a great opportunity! He manages to control a rebound and slams it towards the crossbar from middle distance. Alex Remiro changes the trajectory of the shot with a fabulous last second save, punching it onto the bar and away.
82' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad).
81' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.
81' Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Real Sociedad.
79' Here is a change. Kirian is going off and Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta gives the last tactical orders to Omenuke Mfulu (Las Palmas).
79' Here comes a substitution. Pejino (Las Palmas) is brought on as a substitute for Sandro Ramirez.
79' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Jonathan Viera walks off the pitch to be replaced by Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas).
78' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
75' Imanol Alguacil prepares a substitution. Brais Mendez is replaced by Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad).
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Takefusa Kubo departs the field of play to be replaced by Mohamed-Ali Cho (Real Sociedad).
75' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

74' What a save from Alvaro Valles! Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising low header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out. The referee blows his whistle, Real Sociedad are awarded a corner kick.
72' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) is the one who receives a yellow card.
71' The ball is cleared after Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
70' Kirian (Las Palmas) receives a reproachful look from his teammates after he attempted to surprise the goalkeeper with a shot from long distance. The ball flew far wide of the right post.
68' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta decides to make a substitution. Sory Kaba will be replaced by Javier Munoz (Las Palmas).

68' The flag is raised by the referee's assistant. Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) is repeatedly being caught offside. He's always hanging on the shoulder of the last man to try and get into a scoring position.
67' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle and it's Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
65' Substitution. Sergi Cardona leaves the pitch and is replaced by Saul Coco (Las Palmas).
65' The corner evades everyone in the centre and ends up at the back post where Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) sends a wild header high over the bar.
64' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
59' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
56' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Real Sociedad was in an offside position.
55' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it high over the bar.
55' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) latches on to a pass inside the box, but his low effort towards the right post is well blocked.
53' Real Sociedad can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
53' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Real Sociedad will take a corner kick.
51' The attendance for today's match is 25335.

49' Jonathan Viera (Las Palmas) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Alex Remiro!
48' Jonathan Viera (Las Palmas) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
47' Robin Le Normand (Real Sociedad) brings his opponent down. Guillermo Cuadra has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Las Palmas.
46' The resulting set piece from Real Sociedad is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) is replaced by Mikel Oyarzabal.
46' Imanol Alguacil makes a half-time substitution. Umar Sadiq comes on in place of Carlos Fernandez (Real Sociedad).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+1' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) was quite harsh and Guillermo Cuadra didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
44' Robin Le Normand (Real Sociedad) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
41' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
40' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
39' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Las Palmas comes to nothing.
39' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) takes a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but his effort is well blocked by the defender. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Las Palmas.
38' Las Palmas take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
36' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
33' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) fires the ball towards goal from just outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar after coming very close to hitting the roof of the net.
30' Guillermo Cuadra interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Carlos Fernandez (Real Sociedad).
28' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom left corner, but Alex Remiro pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
27' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) receives a fine cross inside the box and attempts to score a goal, but his strike flies just a few inches over the bar.
26' The referee awards a corner and Jonathan Viera (Las Palmas) goes over to take it.

26' Jonathan Viera (Las Palmas) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. The linesman makes the right call and Las Palmas will have a corner.
25' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
22' Carlos Fernandez (Real Sociedad) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
22' 2:0 – the total goal attempt statistics. 1:0 – this is the current number of shots on target.

15' Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas) was close to scoring a goal after unleashing a first-time strike from just outside the penalty area. The ball was aimed towards the top right corner, but the goalkeeper read it well and pulled off a spectacular save to deflect it onto the post.
13' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
11' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
9' Poor challenge! Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) is penalised for tripping and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle.
7' Sory Kaba (Las Palmas) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
5' CHANCE! Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) picks up a perfect pass inside the box, makes himself some space for a shot, but his effort goes just over the crossbar.
2' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) sends a cross into the box, but Alvaro Valles comes off his line to gather the ball.
1' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle and signals a foul after Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) brought his opponent down.
